name: osdbits-wasm
description: Browser-native Rust/WebAssembly + WebGPU reconstruction of PlayStation 2 OSDSYS visual scenes, forked from aap/osdbits

scripts.test:e2e:smoke: npm run build:wasm && playwright test tests/e2e/smoke.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:wasm && playwright test tests/e2e
scripts.test:visual: npm run build:wasm && playwright test tests/visual
scripts.test:perf: npm run build:wasm && playwright test tests/perf
scripts.test:prod: npm run build && OSDBITS_PROD_PREVIEW=1 playwright test tests/prod
scripts.build: npm run check:legal && npm run build:wasm && npm run typecheck && vite build
scripts.check:all: npm run check:legal && npm run lint:rust && npm run test:rust && npm run test:unit && npm run typecheck && npm run build:web && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:visual && npm run test:perf && npm run test:prod
